sections.title: Painted Cube – Core Concept
sections.content: When a large cube of side ‘L’ is painted on all faces and cut into smaller cubes of side ‘s’, first calculate n. Step 1: n = L / s. Step 2: Total small cubes = n³. Step 3: Classify cubes based on position – corner, edge, face center, or inner.

sections.title: Exact Counting Formulas (Fully Painted Cube)
sections.content: If all 6 faces are painted: Step 1: Cubes with 3 faces painted (corners) = 8. Step 2: Cubes with 2 faces painted (edges) = 12(n-2). Step 3: Cubes with 1 face painted (face centers) = 6(n-2)². Step 4: Cubes with 0 face painted (inner cubes) = (n-2)³. Step 5: Verify total = n³.

sections.title: Example: 4x4x4 Cube (Step Solution)
sections.content: Given: 4x4x4 cm cube painted and cut into 1x1x1 cubes. Step 1: n = 4/1 = 4. Step 2: Total cubes = 4³ = 64. Step 3: 3-face painted = 8. Step 4: 2-face painted = 12(4-2) = 24. Step 5: 1-face painted = 6(4-2)² = 24. Step 6: 0-face painted = (4-2)³ = 8. Step 7: Check total = 8+24+24+8 = 64.

sections.title: Multi-Colored Cube Concept
sections.content: If opposite faces are painted in different colors (e.g., red, green, blue pairs), then: Step 1: Find n. Step 2: Corner cubes will have 3 different colors. Step 3: Edge cubes will have 2 colors. Step 4: Face center cubes will have 1 color. Step 5: Inner cubes will have no color.

sections.title: Example: 3x3x3 Multi-Colored Cube
sections.content: Given: 3x3x3 cube with opposite faces colored in pairs. Step 1: n = 3. Step 2: Total cubes = 27. Step 3: Corners = 8 (each with 3 colors). Step 4: Edges = 12(3-2) = 12. Step 5: Face centers = 6(3-2)² = 6. Step 6: Inner cubes = (3-2)³ = 1.

sections.title: Cuboid (l x b x h) Painted Variation
sections.content: If a cuboid is painted and cut: Step 1: Total cubes = l × b × h. Step 2: Corner cubes = 8 (if all faces painted). Step 3: Edge cubes = 4(l-2) + 4(b-2) + 4(h-2). Step 4: Face center cubes = 2[(l-2)(b-2) + (b-2)(h-2) + (h-2)(l-2)]. Step 5: Inner cubes = (l-2)(b-2)(h-2).

sections.title: Example: 3x4x5 Cuboid (Step Solution)
sections.content: Given: 3x4x5 cuboid painted on all faces and cut into 1x1x1 cubes. Step 1: Total cubes = 3×4×5 = 60. Step 2: Corners = 8. Step 3: Edges = 4(3-2) + 4(4-2) + 4(5-2) = 4 + 8 + 12 = 24. Step 4: Face centers = 2[(1×2) + (2×3) + (3×1)] = 2(2+6+3) = 22. Step 5: Inner cubes = (1×2×3) = 6. Step 6: Verify total = 8+24+22+6 = 60.

sections.title: Advanced Strategy Checklist
sections.content: 1. Always calculate n (or l, b, h). 2. Choose correct formula (cube or cuboid). 3. Remember corners are always 8 if fully painted. 4. Use (n-2) carefully. 5. Always verify by summing all categories to match total cubes.

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.content: 1. Forgetting to subtract 2 in formulas. 2. Mixing cube and cuboid formulas. 3. Not verifying total count. 4. Misclassifying edge and face center cubes.

tricks.title: Find n First
tricks.explanation: Always divide large edge by small edge before applying formulas.
tricks.example: 8 cm cube cut into 2 cm cubes → n = 4.

tricks.title: Corner Rule
tricks.explanation: A fully painted cube always has exactly 8 corner cubes.

tricks.title: Total Verification Rule
tricks.explanation: Sum of all categories must equal total small cubes.
tricks.example: If total is 125, sum of all painted and unpainted cubes must be 125.

tricks.title: Color Identification Trick
tricks.explanation: 3 colors = corner, 2 colors = edge, 1 color = face center, 0 color = inner.
tricks.example: In 4x4x4 multi-colored cube, corners always show 3 colors.
